headline: Ukrainian drones strike Russian chemical plant and oil refinery deep inside Russia
subheadline: Ukrainian long-range drones hit Tolyatti chemical plant and Omsk oil refinery, traveling 2,500–3,000 km to cripple synthetic rubber and fuel for Russian missiles.
lede: Israeli airstrikes in Iraq destroyed Iranian‑transferred Chinese air defense systems near Baghdad, while the IDF killed two Palestinian operatives crossing the Yellow Line in Gaza. Lebanon's southern border erupted with 55 alerts in six hours, including warplane flights, artillery shelling, and drone sightings across multiple districts. Meanwhile, Ukrainian long‑range drones struck the Tolyatti chemical plant and Omsk oil refinery, targeting synthetic rubber and fuel for Russian missiles, prompting Russian Geran‑5 and Shahed drone attacks on Kyiv and civilian areas.

sections.title: Ukrainian Long-Range Drone Strikes Hit Russian Facilities
sections.body: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Tolyatti chemical plant and Omsk oil refinery and cauchuk facility on October 24, traveling 2,500–3,000 km to target synthetic rubber and fuel for Russian missiles. Russian forces responded with massed Geran-5 and Shahed drone attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, while air defenses tracked multiple inbound threats. A Russian drone strike on Synelnykove killed three civilians, including an 11-year-old girl, and injured eight others, destroying residential buildings and vehicles. Ukraine finalized defense industry reservation reforms and announced a humanitarian ceasefire in occupied Oleshky, while the UK and France coordinated nuclear exercises over the Mediterranean.

sections.title: Escalating Cross-Border Violence, Strikes, and Drone Activity
sections.body: Iraqi officials suspect Israeli airstrikes destroyed two warehouses storing Chinese-made air defense systems transferred from Iran to Tehran-backed militias near Baghdad. The IDF eliminated two Palestinian operatives who crossed the Yellow Line in separate incidents in northern and southern Gaza. Lebanon's southern border recorded 55 alerts in six hours, including warplane flights, artillery shelling, and drone sightings across Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil, and Tyre districts. Israeli authorities razed illegal structures near Hebron used as cover by Hamas gunmen, while a Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed a drone over Riyadh, and an Iranian Shahed-136 drone was spotted over Haji Omaran in Iraqi Kurdistan.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Israeli strikes on Iranian weapons transfers in Iraq and the demolition of Hamas cover structures near Hebron indicate a coordinated campaign to degrade militia capabilities across multiple fronts. The surge of 55 alerts on Lebanon's southern border, combined with US transport aircraft presence and Iranian Shahed drones over Iraqi Kurdistan, signals heightened external involvement and potential multi-front escalation. Ukraine's deep‑strike campaign targeting synthetic rubber and fuel production, alongside Russian drone attacks on civilian centers and new defense industry reforms, reflects an intensifying war of attrition on industrial and humanitarian fronts.
